abstract: A 42-year-old man presented with right lower quadrant abdominal pain and dysuria. The bladder was displaced to the right side of the pelvis in excretory urography. Abdominal CT revealed a mass in right adrenal gland, measuring 8 cm in diameter. There was also a cystic mass; filling left half of the bony pelvis and displacing bladder to the right, measuring 14.5 x 10, 5 x 7 cm. The patient underwent right adrenalectomy and pelvic mass excision. Pathologic examination showed that the adrenal mass was pheochromocytoma and pelvic mass was dermoid cyst. This case is the first one in literature that an intrapelvic dermoid cyst is not derived from an organ coexists with pheochromocytoma.
abstract_ja: 42歳男性が右下腹部痛と排尿困難で受診した。排泄性尿路造影では膀胱が骨盤右側に偏位していた。腹部CTで直径8cmの右副腎腫瘤と、左半分の骨盤を占め膀胱を右方へ圧排する嚢胞性腫瘤（14.5×10、5×7cm）が認められた。患者は右副腎摘除術と骨盤内腫瘤切除を受けた。病理学的検査で副腎腫瘤は褐色細胞腫、骨盤内腫瘤は類皮嚢腫と判明した。本症例は、褐色細胞腫と併存した、いかなる臓器にも由来しない骨盤内類皮嚢腫の初めての文献報告である。
